frequency_question: How often does the council successfully enact proposed service tax rate adjustments on financial services when intent is established?
membership_rule: Includes formal council meetings where financial service taxation proposals were tabled by revenue sub-committees; excludes purely administrative clarifications or procedural deferrals not involving rate changes.

cases.name: Casino, racecourse, and online gaming 28% tax clarification
Unprocessed food grain and item branding tax revisions
Oat and allied product tax rate corrections
Financial sector input tax credit adjustments on banking services

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major structural service and financial tax adjustment decisions by the council; believed roughly 6 in total matching this specific sub-category.
known_gaps: Minor state-level exemptions or localized rate revisions omitted as they do not reach the council plenary level.
validity_reason: The voting structure and consensus-seeking mechanics of the council remain stable under constitutional provisions.
